maddeler.e:
ننحبس (form VII)
# نَنْحَبِسُ (nanḥabisu) /nan.ħa.bi.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
# نَنْحَبِسَ (nanḥabisa) /nan.ħa.bi.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
# نَنْحَبِسْ (nanḥabis) /nan.ħa.bis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
